text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... And here I thought I was going to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think there were still areas where my 
own mindset and awareness were lacking.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Surely if I fix that, the results will 
change too... so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For all the hard work you put in, Trainer, 
I'm gonna work even way, waaay harder!
choice_data_list:
Even if it wasn't 1st place, that was a 
great race!

Let's use this result to fuel our next 
step!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what the results are, your eyes 
always sparkle like that, don't they, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of wonderful smile 
she'd show us if she took first place.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'll work extra hard before next 
time so that I can see your brightest 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's run even better next time and 
make sure we win.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If it makes Trainer happy, then bring on 
any kind of training, I'm ready for it♪
